notes.title: HIGHCLEAR VR Patch 1.0.2 - Select Difficulty + Teleport
notes.content:
[list][h1]New additions[/h1]
[*]Added 'SET UP' window.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29293332/6146152095d79409d5b2be33ff8da1f9791e2edc.png[/img]

[*]Added Teleport to the Movement mode.
[*]Adjustable volume.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29293332/a07ec9897917da021971156784d78867c29555a3.png[/img]

[*]You can choose the difficulty level.
[*]Added difficulty score.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29293332/a9bac0a7362e73c6acd33137536d411ca9ac8cb0.png[/img]

[*]Difficulty angle / force correction is entered.
[*]You can check the difficulty level in the game.
[/list]

[list][h1]Modifications[/h1]
[*]Improved AI performance.
[*]Fixed the power to hit the shuttlecock.
[*]We eliminated the phenomenon that the audience overlaps the UI.
[/list]

If you find new bugs in the game or want to improve it, 
please comment on discussion or here.

Thank you.


FIVESTARGAMES

tags.feature: [*]You can check the difficulty level in the game.

tags.bug: [*]Fixed the power to hit the shuttlecock.
[*]We eliminated the phenomenon that the audience overlaps the UI.
